events.outcome: Current provider catalog establishes a 1095-day Hong Kong-number plan at HKD138 and a durable top-up ladder where HKD50 extends number expiry 180 days, HKD100 extends 365 days, and HKD200 extends 540 days. The prior lifecycle blocker is cleared; the cheapest simple verified ongoing annual keep action is HKD100 for 365 days.

Recent independent evidence supports overseas incoming SMS and ordinary mainland-China SMS, but bank and third-party OTP reliability remains insufficiently sampled. Preserve HOLD and do not publish an OTP guarantee or success percentage.

data.acquisitionSummary: LuckySIM currently offers a HKD138 prepaid plan valid 1095 days with 30GB Hong Kong data, 2,000 local minutes and a retained Hong Kong mobile number. The official plan supports physical SIM/eSIM, voice and SMS, and requires real-name registration.

keep.action: Before number expiry, top up HKD100 through the current LuckySIM top-up channel to reset/extend the SIM number expiry by 365 days. Current alternatives are HKD50/180 days and HKD200/540 days; validity is counted from the new top-up transaction rather than stacked onto remaining days.

data.chinaActivation: Real-name registration is required before use. A September 2026 community report says ordinary non-bank SMS was reliable in Hong Kong/mainland China, but a universal mainland-China-first activation path and bank/OTP reliability are not established.
data.kyc: Required. LuckySIM's current plan requires real-name registration before use, and OFCA lists LuckySIM/Amoeba Limited in the prepaid-SIM registration directory.
data.payment: LuckySIM provides online purchase/top-up. Current independent operational guidance reproduces online renewal using card/Alipay/WeChat Pay, but payment-method acceptance can vary by user and region.
data.wifiCalling: not normalized; a 2026 independent guide reports Wi-Fi Calling is not supported, but this review does not treat that as provider-guaranteed fact.
data.roamingSms: HOLD. Current provider plan supports roaming calls/SMS capability, and 2026 independent evidence reproduces free incoming SMS in the UK plus ordinary SMS in mainland China. Bank and third-party OTP reliability is not sufficiently sampled for a guarantee.
data.refund: Official product purchase is non-refundable/non-exchangeable after purchase; broader recovery/refund cases are not reconciled.
data.holdReason: Lifecycle and renewal are now verified, but service-specific bank/third-party OTP reliability in mainland China/overseas remains too thin for recommendation status, and overseas network attachment can require manual selection. Keep backstage HOLD until stronger independent verification evidence exists.
data.tariffSummary: HKD138 for a 1095-day Hong Kong-number plan; verified ongoing retention via HKD100 top-up for 365 days. Real-name registration required; OTP reliability remains HOLD.
guideSteps: Acquire a current LuckySIM Hong Kong-number plan and complete real-name registration before relying on the number.
Test ordinary incoming SMS and every critical bank/app verification flow in the actual destination before binding important accounts.
Before expiry, top up HKD100 under the current provider ladder and verify that the number expiry resets to 365 days from the transaction date.
